dict.string: This app requires access to your GPS location to verify your presence at client outlets for check-in/check-out, record attendance, and display nearby stores on the map. For example, when you perform a store check-in to submit a Purchase Order Booking (POB), the app uses your location to confirm you are physically at that outlet location.

This app requires access to your GPS location while using the app to show nearby client outlets on the map, verify your proximity to stores for check-in and check-out, and record your attendance. For example, when you check in to submit a Purchase Order Booking (POB) at a store, the app checks your GPS location to confirm you are within 50 meters of that specific outlet.

This app requires continuous access to your location to track sales routes, verify proximity to client outlets, and record attendance check-ins even when the app is in the background or closed. For example, tracking your route while traveling between stores to log sales visits and verify store check-ins automatically.

This app requires access to your location in both the foreground and background to track sales routes, verify proximity to client outlets, and record attendance check-ins. For example, when you travel between client outlets, we track your route to calculate travel distance and verify you are at the correct store location to perform check-ins.

This app requires access to your camera to capture photos of store displays, marketing materials, and products. For example, taking a photo of a shelf display when registering promotional materials at an outlet.

This app requires access to your photo library to select and upload saved images of receipts, product displays, or branding materials. For example, attaching a saved invoice image to a Purchase Order Booking (POB).
